notes.title: 2.0 Update Notes
notes.content: This update grandly commences, with a brand-new human-machine battle mode making a dazzling debut, bringing you an unprecedented competitive thrill. At the same time, we have meticulously selected and integrated a variety of new music with distinct styles to enrich your gaming experience even further. Moreover, we have made meticulous adjustments to the game's visuals, adding background patterns that change in rhythm with the music.
